contract.goal: Implement configurable opt-in AI title and category suggestions with explicit minimal-data consent, manual acceptance, protected credentials and stale-response safety.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/thinkV2, clean baseline84f3691f97efaae6e9fdbb7c81405e6525770e38 after accepted CP4. Authoritative approved emulator-first addendum E7 I1-I6 and existing baseline. One CP5 task; no inheritance of old think implementation/evidence.

I1: Default disabled. Implement endpoint/model/credential configuration, disable and clear. Use Android platform-protected credential storage; no shared hardcoded keys, logs, Git or backup secrets. Clearly document supported request protocol and endpoint form. Missing/invalid/unavailable configuration is honest unavailable state; local title/manual category remain usable.

I2: Before enable or sending, show supplier/purpose/exact fields and obtain explicit consent; endpoint/provider change invalidates consent. User deliberately requests suggestions for selected current note and can review minimal outgoing text plus needed category candidates. No raw audio, whole database, unrelated source calendar/account metadata, recycled notes or unrelated relations. Imported body includes readable source metadata: make outgoing selection explicit/minimal, do not blindly send the immutable provenance snapshot. No automatic request, fallback provider, account signup or payment.

I3: Separate title/category proposals allow accept/edit/reject. Never overwrite body or silently change manual title/category. Bind request and response application to recordId, revision and title/category ownership; note switch, edits or obsolete category invalidate affected result. New category remains an explicit user-confirmed proposal, not automatic creation. Persist accepted AI provenance separately from final manual choice as necessary for future backup.

I4: Real asynchronous request adapter with timeout, request/response size limits, cancellation and duplicate prevention. Record parameters. Disable/cancel invalidates late output and explains sent text cannot be recalled. Offline,429,5xx, malformed/empty/injected responses preserve notes and saving. Strict bounded response structure, no arbitrary action/script/body-replacement execution. Confirmed HTTPS destination and credential boundaries maintained across redirects; no silent host change, permissive TLS or secret-bearing logs.

I5: Meaningful host and real Android emulator UI tests with clearly labeled synthetic mock service for configuration/consent/outgoing fields, accept/edit/reject, timeout/cancel, stale response, offline/error/invalid content and restart. Product transport is real, mock is evidence only for controlled adapter behavior. Real provider request only if user has actually configured and authorized a test endpoint; currently no such endpoint/credential/consent supplied. Never search other projects/secrets or acquire keys. Track provider_verified=false if unavailable; do not block independent engineering or claim real AI quality.

Preserve notes/drafts/categories/recycle/reminders/calendar/voice behavior and IDs. Necessary schema migration must be safe. Document current backup exclusions for newly persisted provenance/settings; do not silently expand backup schema. Credentials and temporary suggestions never exported; final CP8 remains separately pending. Add INTERNET only as necessary for explicitly enabled AI path; offline local features stay functional. Prefer current/platform dependencies; any new object requires existing safety gate.

I6: Xiaomi15, user real-service configuration and family testing remain final phase. Provide usable configuration/request/acceptance feature now, plus accurate real-provider condition list. No placeholder AI labeled working, no rule-based fallback marketed as model inference.
out_of_scope: No voice candidate/quality/control work, relations implementation, full-feature backup format change, account/sync/payment/public publishing, cloud ASR, Flutter/KMP or private-device access. No new independent developer task.

No private note transmission or real service request without actual user configuration and testing consent. Do not read unrelated local credentials. No automatically enabled AI or whole-library processing.
acceptance: I1-I4 and configuration/request adapter UI complete with meaningful host and Android synthetic-service evidence; enabled sending requires accurate consent and user request; disable/default-off and manual workflows preserved.

I5 actual-provider condition explicitly classified: unavailable configuration leaves provider_verified=false and exact gap. Controlled mocks never prove real AI quality or provider compatibility beyond tested protocol. Engineering result and external service gap reported separately; no full-App completion.

Migration, cancellation/staleness/error/secret handling evidence and affected local-feature regressions pass; standard offline build/lint pass; no unknown dependency, no unrelated source modifications.
Exact final commit/clean state/APK hashes, reproducible sanitized test evidence and I1-I6 matrix; Xiaomi/family/backup obligations explicit.
evidence_required: ACK exact task/attempt/contract/baseline. Completion RESULT COMPLETE/BLOCKED/PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED with separate engineering and provider_verified status; file purposes; tests/commands/results; captured synthetic request fields and consent/secret/stale/error tests; I1-I6 mapping; final Git/APK/dependency identities; limitations and one proposed next step then stop. No credentials or personal text in evidence.
stop_conditions: One CP5 task only; do not begin relations, voice or CP8 work. Stop after delivery and notify commander. Do not overwrite unidentified changes.

Stop affected action for unauthorized network data/credential disclosure, unknown dependency, destructive migration or actual product/privacy boundary change; report evidence and preserve safe independent progress. Missing real-provider credentials is a documented external validation gap, not permission to fake output or obtain credentials.
